articles.summary: SOUTH SAN FRANCISCO, Calif., May 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- CytomX Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: CTMX), a leader in the field of masked, conditionally activated biologics, today announced the appointment of Mamata Gokhale, Ph.D., RAC, as Senior Vice President of Regulatory Affairs.
